provenance.note: Small-savings rates are the Jul-Sep 2026 (Q2 FY2026-27) quarter, per Ministry of Finance notification dated 30 June 2026, unchanged for the ninth consecutive quarter — the Oct-Dec 2026 notification was not yet issued as of this pack's verification date (typically issued around 30 September). EPF/VPF are the FY2025-26 EPFO-ratified rate, the latest declared at verification time (see per-entry citation). Every product's rate is cited individually below since they come from separate (if related) notifications and declaration cycles, following the same citations pattern as the income-tax and stamp-duty packs.

products.ppf.rate.note: 7.1% for Jul-Sep 2026 (Q2 FY2026-27), per Ministry of Finance notification dated 30 June 2026, unchanged for the ninth consecutive quarter. Cross-checked against newsonair.gov.in (Government of India's own news agency).

products.ssy.rate.note: 8.2% for Jul-Sep 2026, same notification as PPF above.

products.kvp.rate.note: 7.5% and the 115-month/2.5-year-lock-in figures cross-checked against the same Jul-Sep 2026 Ministry of Finance notification (via Upstox) as the other small-savings products; the 115-month doubling period independently reproduced by this project's own `yearsToDouble(0.075)` calculation (≈115.01 months), confirming the cited figure rather than trusting it blind.

products.scss.rate.note: 8.2% for Jul-Sep 2026, same notification as PPF above.

products.potd_1y.rate.note: 6.9% for Jul-Sep 2026, per the same 30 June 2026 Ministry of Finance notification.

products.pord.rate.note: 6.7% for Jul-Sep 2026, same notification as PPF above.

products.posa.rate.note: 4.0% for Jul-Sep 2026, same notification; this rate has been unchanged for many years independent of the quarterly small-savings cycle.

products.epf.rate.note: 8.25% ratified and notified for FY2025-26 — the latest EPFO-declared rate at verification time. FY2026-27's rate is declared only after that year ends, so this figure is one year behind the small-savings quarter above by the nature of EPFO's own declaration cycle, not an oversight.

products.vpf.rate.note: VPF earns the same rate as EPF by rule (deposits sit in the same account) — not an independently notified figure.

ppf.label: Public Provident Fund (PPF)
ppf.eligibility: Any resident Indian individual (including a minor's account operated by a guardian); NRIs cannot open new accounts.
ppf.notes: Interest is calculated monthly on the lowest balance between the 5th and last day of the month, but credited to the account only once a year (31 March) — this pack ships the annual rate and the engine models a simplified once-a-year contribution/compounding cycle (deposit before 5 April each year to earn the full year's interest, standard PPF advice). Partial withdrawal allowed from the 7th financial year; loan against balance available from the 3rd to 6th year. Extendable in blocks of 5 years after the initial 15.

ssy.label: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ssy.eligibility: A girl child under 10 years of age at account opening, one account per girl (max two per family, three in the case of twins/triplets on the second birth).
ssy.notes: Contributions may be made for 15 years from account opening; the account itself matures 21 years from opening, or on the girl's marriage after age 18, whichever is earlier — so the balance keeps earning interest (undisbursed) between year 15 and maturity even though contributions have stopped. This pack's engine wiring assumes the horizon requested is within the 15-year contribution window; a longer horizon needs the balance to be carried forward at the same rate with zero further contribution, not modelled by `compoundAnnualContributions` alone.

nsc.label: National Savings Certificate (NSC)
nsc.eligibility: Any resident Indian individual; no NRI eligibility.
nsc.notes: Interest compounds annually but is paid out only at maturity (5 years), not annually. Interest for years 1-4 is deemed reinvested and itself qualifies for a fresh Section 80C deduction each year (subject to the overall ₹1.5L cap); the final year's interest is taxable with no offsetting fresh deduction since the certificate matures. No premature-withdrawal option except on the holder's death or by court order.

kvp.label: Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP)
kvp.eligibility: Any resident Indian individual; no NRI eligibility.
kvp.notes: Maturity period is the doubling period implied by the shipped rate (115 months ≈ 9 years 5 months at 7.5%, matching the officially cited figure — see the engine's `yearsToDouble` helper, which derives this from the rate rather than shipping a separately-sourced period that could drift out of sync with it). Premature encashment is not permitted before 30 months (2.5 years) except on the holder's death, forfeiture by a pledgee, or court order. TDS of 10% is deducted annually on accrued interest even though it is paid only at maturity.

scss.label: Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS)
scss.eligibility: Individuals aged 60+ (55+ for retired defence personnel, 50+ for retired civilian employees under superannuation/VRS, subject to deposit-timing conditions).
scss.notes: Interest is paid out quarterly, not compounded back into the balance — this pack ships the annual rate; a caller projecting SCSS should treat it as an income stream (quarterly payout) rather than feeding it through `compoundAnnually`, since it doesn't compound. Extendable once by 3 years after the initial 5-year maturity. ₹30L combined per individual across all SCSS accounts.

pomis.label: Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (POMIS)
pomis.eligibility: Any resident Indian individual; joint accounts (up to 3 holders) permitted.
pomis.notes: Interest is paid out monthly, not compounded — an income stream, same treatment note as SCSS above. ₹9L max for a single account, ₹15L for a joint account (each joint holder's individual-account limit is reduced by their proportional joint-account share).

potd_1y.label: Post Office Time Deposit — 1 year
potd_1y.notes: Interest compounds quarterly but is payable annually. Premature closure allowed after 6 months at a reduced rate (Post Office Savings Account rate for a 6-11 month holding).

potd_2y.label: Post Office Time Deposit — 2 year
potd_2y.notes: Same premature-closure and compounding rules as the 1-year Time Deposit.

potd_3y.label: Post Office Time Deposit — 3 year
potd_3y.notes: Same premature-closure and compounding rules as the 1-year Time Deposit.

potd_5y.label: Post Office Time Deposit — 5 year
potd_5y.notes: Only the 5-year Time Deposit qualifies for Section 80C. Used as this calculator's sourced default for a generic bank FD — a real bank's own FD rate varies by bank and tenure and should be entered directly by the user when known; this is a government-backed reference point, not a claim that every bank offers 7.5%.

pord.label: Post Office Recurring Deposit (RD)
pord.notes: Quarterly compounding on a monthly contribution stream; this pack's engine wiring approximates it via the existing monthly-nominal-rate SIP machinery (`compoundContributions`/`sipFutureValue` in compounding.ts) rather than modelling the exact quarterly-credit mechanics — a documented simplification, immaterial at these rates over realistic horizons. Premature closure allowed after 3 years at the Post Office Savings Account rate.

posa.label: Post Office Savings Account (POSA)
posa.notes: Interest up to ₹10,000/year is exempt under Section 80TTA (old regime, non-senior); shown here as the gross rate, with the exemption left to the income-tax calculator rather than modelled inside this pack.

epf.label: Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)
epf.eligibility: Salaried employees of an establishment covered under the EPF & MP Act, 1952 (mandatory above a headcount threshold; employee's own 12% contribution is mandatory once covered).
epf.notes: Rate shown is for FY2025-26, the latest EPFO-ratified figure at the time this pack was verified — the FY2026-27 rate had not yet been declared (EPFO typically declares a financial year's rate only after it ends). Mandatory employee contribution is 12% of basic + dearness allowance; the employer matches 12%, of which 8.33% (capped to a ₹15,000/month wage ceiling) is diverted to the Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS) rather than compounding in the EPF account — this pack's `rate` and engine wiring model only the EPF corpus itself, not EPS. EEE if the employee completes 5 years of continuous service (across employers, if transferred via UAN); interest on the employee's own contribution above ₹2.5L/year (₹5L/year if the employer makes no contribution at all) is taxable — modelled via `taxableInterestThresholdPerYear`, not yet wired into the income-tax engine as of Phase 6.

vpf.label: Voluntary Provident Fund (VPF)
vpf.eligibility: Any employee already covered by EPF, as a voluntary top-up beyond the mandatory 12%.
vpf.notes: Earns the same rate as EPF by rule, since VPF deposits sit in the same EPF account — not an independently notified rate. The ₹2.5L/year taxable-interest threshold is combined across EPF + VPF employee contributions together, not ₹2.5L each. Same 5-year continuous-service condition for tax-free withdrawal as EPF; the employee cannot withdraw VPF independently of EPF.
